title: Sharp homogeneous Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequalities and normalized solutions for generalized stationary MMT equations
summary: We prove the existence of optimizers for a class of homogeneous Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequalities of the form $$ \|D^{s}φ\|_{L^q} \leq C \|D^{s_1}φ\|_{L^p}^{1-θ} \|D^{s_2}φ\|_{L^2}^θ, \quad s_1 s_1$, the problem reduces, after shifting the derivative orders, to the result of Bellazzini, Frank and Visciglia, whereas the case $s\leq s_1$ follows from the present paper.
